text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In a sudden turn of events, Umamusume
from
around the world will be arriving
for an
impromptu cultural exchange
festival.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: While I'm decorating the campus...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
The hallway decorations seem to be
coming along
nicely. I suppose this
display case is the one
dedicated to the
academy's history.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
It features a variety of memorabilia lent
to us by
the director. I ask that everyone
here handles it
with care.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Eeek!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Is everything okay? Are you hurt?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Thanks, I'm okay, but... I just left a dent
in the
director's prized wooden
sculpture!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... It's a sculpture of an
Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I'll take responsibility for this. Continue
with your
tasks—I'll go and tell the
director.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Air Groove!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Hm, looking at these dimensions, a piste
should
be within reason. This should
allow us to hold
proper duels.

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Bravo! If it will instill great excitement,
then
absolutely!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
There you are, Director Akikawa. And
you too,
President.

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Why yes! We were just in discussions
about the
fencing show, one of the
events scheduled for the
cultural
exchange festival!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
My apologies for interrupting, but I have

something to tell you.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Your wooden sculpture has been
damaged due to
my poor leadership. I
am truly sorry.

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
What a shame! A true shame, indeed!
However...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
All things are transient. Perhaps its time
had
come...

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
As such, a suggestion! Assume the role
of Rudolf's
training partner! If you
emerge victorious, then I
shall overlook
this incident!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Would you do me the honor, Air
Groove? I
cannot find anyone to spar
with me.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Ah, a fencing partner? If you would have
me as
your partner, then I would be
delighted to.

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Excellent! Then, let us begin!
Rassemblez, saluez!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Come, and show me what you're made
of. May
the talents of your blade bloom
forth with pride!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
This may be a mere mock duel, but as
the proud
Empress, I know not of defeat!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After a fierce exchange of offensive and

defensive blows, Air Groove racks up
enough
points and wins!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Phew... Your defense was impenetrable.
The
Empress of our fair academy is as
swift as a bolt
of lightning.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Your humility speaks volumes. I would
have stood
no chance if you dueled in
earnest.

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
A decisive win! I expected no less of
you, Air
Groove. Very well, I shall
overlook the sculpture
incident!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After a fierce exchange of offensive and

defensive blows, Symboli Rudolf racks
up enough
points and wins!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Your skills were far superior to mine. I

concede—you are worthy to be heralded
as the
Emperor.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
In reality, the difference was paper thin.
I became
quite stubborn by the end of
our match.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I wasn't convinced I could win with the
ease of an
emperor against your
prowess.

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
A close duel! Also, an excellent and rare
one! I
shall acknowledge your skills and
overlook the
sculpture incident!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
And now, a question! What kind of wood
was the
sculpture carved from?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Perhaps... oak?

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Correct! And that Umamusume
sculpture...

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Was modeled on the illustrious,
extremely
popular Queen who
conquered the Japanese
Oaks.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: The Queen...

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
I implore you to continue your efforts.
May they
truly befit that of royalty!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I am sincerely grateful for the immense
leniency
you have shown.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Now, if you'll excuse me.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Air Groove leaves with a bow, swiftly
returning to
oversee the event
preparations.
